summary: Extended backend tests for speaker-turn detection + turn-level TTS. Added /app/backend/tests/test_turns.py with 8 new tests. All 28 pytest tests (20 prior + 8 new) pass. Verified: turns field populated on upload and on GET; inline 'SPEAKER: text' style yields JANE/MARK/JANE (3 turns) with correct bodies; screenplay style (label on own line) yields ROMEO/JULIET/ROMEO; consecutive same-speaker blocks are merged into one turn; existing seed scene 4b23e55d-... returns turns via GET; WordToken.turn_index present on tokens and speaker-label tokens (e.g. the word 'JANE' preceding ':') have turn_index=null while dialogue words are int-indexed; POST /api/scenes/{id}/turns/{i}/tts happy path returns cached=false then cached=true (real ElevenLabs 200 with non-empty audio_b64, mime=audio/mpeg, correct speaker); 404 for unknown scene and out-of-range turn_index.

minor.issue: Negative turn_index like -1 is accepted by FastAPI path param (int) and app returns 404 — fine. Consider a Path(ge=0) constraint for a cleaner 422 on obviously invalid values.

critical_code_review_comments: extract_turns() correctly prefers screenplay style when >=2 solo labels detected, else falls back to inline regex — validated by both PDF fixtures.
_push_turn() merge logic (same speaker consecutive) works — validated with adjacent ROMEO/ROMEO blocks merging into one turn.
assign_token_turns() maps tokens by character midpoint — dialogue tokens get an int turn_index, tokens in the speaker-label gap get turn_index=None as required.
Turn TTS caches under key 'sceneId:turnIndex' in db.turn_audio_cache and returns cached=true on repeat; audio bytes identical between calls (verified).
get_scene recomputes turns on each GET, so pre-feature scenes automatically gain turns — good for backward compatibility.
Minor: turn_index bounds could use FastAPI Path(ge=0) but current app-level 404 is acceptable and consistent with the scene 404 pattern.
seed_data_creation: Three in-memory PDF scenes uploaded per module and deleted at teardown: inline (JANE/MARK/JANE), screenplay (ROMEO/JULIET/ROMEO), merge (ROMEO/ROMEO/JULIET). Also read-only access to seeded scene 4b23e55d-67be-42bc-a397-4eb4085bdb2e.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run full suite: cd /app/backend && export $(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && python -m pytest tests/ -v. Real ElevenLabs (paid key) now returns 200 with audio — the tts_turn happy path asserts non-empty audio_b64 and cache round-trip; if a future iteration re-encounters upstream 502, the test will pytest.skip that one assertion rather than fail.
rca of the issue: No bugs. Turn detection, token turn_index assignment, and turn-level TTS caching all behave per spec.
